$comment: Registry of the metric ids in history.ndjson: how /status/ labels, groups and judges each one. A new id in history.ndjson gets its own chart even before it is listed here (with a build warning); add it here to give it a label, unit, group, direction and budget. See docs/perf/README.md.

soak.heapStartMB.label: Heap at first cycle boundary
soak.heapStartMB.source: memory soak summary.json (usedJSHeapSize after GC, MiB)

soak.heapEndMB.label: Heap at last cycle boundary
soak.heapEndMB.source: memory soak summary.json (usedJSHeapSize after GC, MiB)

soak.heapGrowthMBPerCycle.label: Heap growth per cycle
soak.heapGrowthMBPerCycle.source: memory soak summary.json (slope over cycle boundaries)

soak.frameP50Ms.label: Frame time p50 (soak, SwiftShader)
soak.frameP50Ms.source: memory soak summary.json (median of the 10-s samples of the frame p50: rAF until #99, the game's render stats since; software GL, not a GPU)

soak.frameP95Ms.label: Frame time p95 (soak, SwiftShader)
soak.frameP95Ms.source: memory soak summary.json (median of the 10-s samples of the frame p95: rAF until #99, the game's render stats since; software GL, not a GPU)

profile.stateDigestMainThreadPct.label: stateDigest share of main-thread samples
profile.stateDigestMainThreadPct.source: browser CPU profile summary (inclusive %), every caller of the state hash (#101)

authority.readStateUs.label: Authority state read (readAuthorityState) · 10.5 KB state
authority.readStateUs.source: readCost.ts on the perf box (#101): median per read over 15 batches of 20, after 720 drill reports

authority.snapshotOfUs.label: Authority snapshotOf (state + digest) · 10.5 KB state
authority.snapshotOfUs.source: readCost.ts on the perf box (#101): median per call over 15 batches of 20, after 720 drill reports

profile.garbageCollectorMainThreadPct.label: Garbage collector share of main-thread samples

stack.toCanonicalJson.maxOkDepth.label: toCanonicalJson deepest nesting survived (default stack)
stack.toCanonicalJson.maxOkDepth.source: stack stress (deepest tested depth before the first RangeError)

stack.payloadProblems.maxOkDepth.label: payloadProblems deepest nesting survived (default stack)
stack.payloadProblems.maxOkDepth.source: stack stress (deepest tested depth before the first RangeError)

authority.canonicalJsonFourPlayerUs.label: toCanonicalJson of a fresh 4-player authority state (3.3 KB)
authority.canonicalJsonFourPlayerUs.source: perf-100 walker tool: median of 5 runs, each the median of 7 rounds x 3000 calls (#100)

authority.stateDigestFourPlayerUs.label: stateDigest of a fresh 4-player authority state (3.3 KB)
authority.stateDigestFourPlayerUs.source: perf-100 walker tool: median of 5 runs, each the median of 7 rounds x 1000 calls (#100)

lookChange.geometriesPerToggle.label: three geometries kept per vehicle look change (visual tier + rack, after GC)
lookChange.geometriesPerToggle.source: preview build, 12 visual-tier/rack toggles via steampunkDebug, renderer.info.memory (#118)

lookChange.texturesPerToggle.label: three textures kept per vehicle look change (visual tier + rack, after GC)
lookChange.texturesPerToggle.source: preview build, 12 visual-tier/rack toggles via steampunkDebug, renderer.info.memory (#118)

debugMemory.seamProbeMismatches.label: Debug memory reads that disagree with probe.js (getPhysicsStats + ui.getRendererMemory)
debugMemory.seamProbeMismatches.source: preview build, 5 drive-and-drill cycles x 5 samples, probe.js injected beside steampunkDebug (#119)

debugMemory.getRendererMemoryCallUs.label: ui.getRendererMemory() per call (median; at Chrome's timer resolution)
debugMemory.getRendererMemoryCallUs.source: preview build, 1000 calls per sample in page, SwiftShader (#119)

debugMemory.getPhysicsStatsCallUs.label: getPhysicsStats() per call (median; at Chrome's timer resolution)
debugMemory.getPhysicsStatsCallUs.source: preview build, 1000 calls per sample in page, SwiftShader (#119)
